title: Computer-use and browser agents
summary: When there's no API, an agent can look at the screen and click like a person.

steps.label: goal
steps.title: A task on a site with no API
payload: "Download last month's invoice from the supplier portal"

steps.label: screenshot
steps.title: Look
steps.text: The runtime takes a screenshot. That image is the model's only view of the screen.
payload: Images cost tokens too; smaller screens are cheaper.

steps.label: screenshot + goal
steps.title: Decide
steps.text: The model finds the right element visually and returns an action with pixel coordinates.

steps.label: click
steps.title: Act
steps.text: The runtime performs the click, waits for the page, and takes a new screenshot. Repeat.
payload: Like the agent loop, but with eyes.

steps.label: type
steps.title: Fill in forms
steps.text: Typing, scrolling and key presses are all actions. Passwords should come from a vault the runtime fills in, never from the model.

steps.label: invoice.pdf
steps.title: Done, slowly
steps.text: Computer use is flexible but slow and fragile compared to an API. Run it in a sandbox, and treat everything on screen as untrusted.
